confidence_notes: The FX rate is the RBA daily USD/AUD observation for 18 Nov 2026. It came from a search summary of the official RBA exchange-rates page, not from reading the page directly. Restaurant meal and cappuccino anchors are close to several crowdsourced cost-of-living figures found by web search: inexpensive meal about US$3.6-3.7 (about NT$120), mid-range dinner for two about US$25-31, cappuccino about US$2.6-2.8 (about NT$90). Those sources were updated at different times between 2023 and 2026. The searches gave a domestic beer figure of about NT$50 (US$1.55). That looks like a shop or very cheap venue price, so the restaurant draft beer anchor was raised to about NT$90 based on general knowledge. The beer anchor is therefore uncertain. The only cocktail figure found was a single dated Expatistan data point (NT$200 in a club). Bar listings showed broad ranges of NT$200-1,000, so the cocktail anchor of about NT$300 is a bounded judgement for an ordinary bar or restaurant. No good aggregated data was found for wine by the glass. That anchor (about NT$250) is based on the usual Taiwanese gap between wine, beer and cocktail prices. All accommodation anchors are general-knowledge model estimates. They were not checked against live listings and are less certain than the food anchors, especially for the July 2026 summer window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Kaohsiung-specific crowdsourced food and drink prices, cross-checked against Taichung and somewhat lower Taipei price levels. Accommodation is benchmarked to typical Taiwanese second-tier cities with moderate tourism demand.
